name: argos-capacitor
//: Android only for now. iOS is deferred (no Mac available): later run `npm i -E @capacitor/ios@8.5.2 -w products/capacitor` then `npx cap add ios`.
appId com.infor.argos.saleslogix in capacitor.config.json is a placeholder; confirm the real bundle id before publishing.
Prerequisite: both deploy/ folders (argos-sdk, products/argos-saleslogix). `npm run build:web` runs both build\release.cmd (sdk first); Windows only (JsBit .exe + cmd).

`npm run android` = build www + cap sync + cap run android (builds the debug APK, installs, launches). Boots a stopped AVD itself. Pick a device: `npm run android -- --target Medium_Phone`; list them: `npx cap run android --list`.
`npm run android:full` = build:web + android, e.g. `npm run android:full -- --target Medium_Phone`. From the repo root: `npm run android` / `npm run android:full` (same args).

scripts.sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.android:full: npm run build:web && npm run android --
